## Purpose

Open a selected ODK Collect form and return the matched form, project, instance and launch status.

## Capability IDs

- `odk_form_launcher`

## Requirements

- ODK Collect installed.
- Target project and form present on the device.

## Supported XLSForm calls


**From `example_odk_odk_form_launcher.xlsx`:**

```text
com.example.researchos.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='odk_form_launcher',input_form_selector=${input_form_selector},return_mode='flat')
```
